provenance.P: Published — the agency's own document states this figure.
provenance.D: Derived — recomputed here by summing the itemised rows the same document prints above that total.

method: Every pair below is one published control total and our recomputation of it from the document's own cells. A pair that agrees is a published figure corroborated by its own components. A pair that disagrees beyond the rounding band implied by how the source prints its figures is recorded as a defect in the source, never corrected.
dual_method: Months marked dual-gated were additionally read twice end to end, by extraction engines that share no code (PyMuPDF vs pdfplumber for PDFs, openpyxl vs the raw sheet XML for workbooks). A day enters these files only when both readings agree on every figure; days they disagree on are withheld and listed per month.
